caption:
If your toddler's Thanksgiving dinner is three rolls and a spoonful of cranberry sauce, you're in good company.

Half of kids are called picky by age 2, and their appetites naturally slow down after the baby year.

Pressure backfires: preschoolers ate more when nobody pushed. What works is quiet, repeated tries. A new food may need 10 to 15 before it sticks.

For Thursday: one safe food on the plate, tiny tastes of everything else, a heads-up for the relatives, and permission to get down when they're done.
